wasm.identity.rationale: 32 MiB leaves 19.4% above the 28,093,335-byte Release baseline, enough for normal product growth while immediately rejecting debug/name sections or another multi-megabyte dependency.

wasm.br.rationale: 10 MiB leaves 13.6% above the 9,231,277-byte Brotli baseline. This is the preferred user transfer representation, so it has the tightest headroom.

wasm.gzip.rationale: 12 MiB leaves 14.2% above the 11,022,360-byte gzip baseline and protects hosts or clients where Brotli is unavailable.

archive.rationale: 35 MiB leaves 16.6% above the 31,466,796-byte deterministic release-archive baseline while bounding the complete identity/Brotli/gzip publication payload.

contributorAudit.featureExclusionMethod: Each row is one successful Release relink with only the named feature flag disabled. Delta is the complete-profile module minus that variant; rows are marginal and not additive because dependencies are shared.

featureExclusions.name: Scene3D, Assimp, Draco, Cloudini, and Scene3D widgets
Protobuf parser, libprotobuf, and retained Abseil
MCAP source with marginal retained LZ4/Zstd code

contributorAudit.linkMapMethod: wasm-ld --Map retained-section sizes before Emscripten's Binaryen post-link optimization. These values name material static inputs but are not delivered bytes and must not be added to the feature-exclusion deltas.

largestPreBinaryenInputs.name: PlotJuggler application resources (including the 2,049,096-byte Noto Sans source font)

contributorAudit.nonIsolatableFinding: PJ_WASM_WITH_LUAU=OFF does not currently compile because pj_runtime unconditionally includes the scripting catalogue. The final link map retains 524,636 pre-Binaryen bytes across Luau VM, compiler, AST, and common archives; no false delivered-size delta is reported.
